name: plural_nouns
description: Give the plural of an English noun (regular and irregular), few-shot. Control: same nouns, copy the singular.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
N=[('cat','cats'),('dog','dogs'),('house','houses'),('car','cars'),('tree','trees'),('book','books'),('boy','boys'),('girl','girls'),('child','children'),('mouse','mice'),('man','men'),('woman','women'),('foot','feet'),('tooth','teeth'),('goose','geese'),('person','people'),('box','boxes'),('city','cities'),('baby','babies'),('knife','knives'),('leaf','leaves'),('wolf','wolves'),('church','churches'),('bus','buses'),('story','stories'),('glass','glasses'),('potato','potatoes'),('hero','heroes'),('life','lives'),('wife','wives'),('ox','oxen'),('cactus','cacti'),('fish','fish'),('sheep','sheep'),('apple','apples'),('table','tables'),('chair','chairs'),('bird','birds'),('party','parties'),('dish','dishes'),('family','families'),('horse','horses')]
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(N,3)
    items.append({"prompt":"Plural.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {b}\n" for a,b in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"Repeat the noun.\n"+"".join(f"{a}: {a}\n" for a,b in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
